answer_1.quote: In the last few years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown outstanding abilities in natural language processing tasks and beyond.
answer_1.outputs: generated statements, true and false facts, factoid sentences

answer_2.quote: Performance is evaluated using Accuracy, AUC, Accuracy with an Optimal Threshold... and the Average Optimal Threshold.

answer_3.quote: Following LLM-as-judge practices, the LLM-generated answers in D M QA can be annotated using an oracle LLM, which we assume is able to evaluate the veracity of each answer a M i,k given the ground-truth answer a i and the question q i.

answer_4.quote: the responses were manually fact-checked and annotated by three independent human judges.
answer_4.guideline: Non-factual responses were filtered out, resulting in a final set of 245 statements.
